content.thinking:
I'm settling on the wording: saved copies stopped updating for a reason the thinking doesn't show, so account pages kept displaying stale totals. I'll say "some shoppers" rather than all of them, since the cause only names each shopper's running spend total as affected, not every copy. The duration will read as "at least {duration}."

I'm dropping the PR number and just noting that a draft fix exists and hasn't run, since leadership doesn't need the identifier. I'll also note that the customer-loss figure is an Argus estimate and that no on-call person was paged.

input.overview: For at least {duration}, account pages on io-shop showed some shoppers a spend total that left out their latest purchases. The shop keeps saved copies of each shopper's running spend total. These copies stopped being updated with new purchases, and the record does not show why. Account pages kept showing the out-of-date copies, likely because a page did not check a copy against the shopper's purchases before showing it. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, so no on-call responder was called in. Argus threw away the out-of-date saved figures, and it has confirmed that this step worked. Argus also wrote a proposed fix, which is still a draft and has not been put into use.
